content: Volume/muted: Instagram Reels autoplay MUTED by default; a volume lever has zero audible effect until the user unmutes (and on iOS, unmuting without a user gesture pauses playback per WebKit policy). Extensions fighting Instagram's media state (kbrianps/instagram-video-controls, igtool) show Instagram's React code sets muted/volume per video and resets state on navigation; extensions track volumechange events and revert non-user-intentional changes. Engine setting video.volume fires volumechange/ratechange events that Instagram's React handlers observe -> volume slider/mute UI desync + a (low) observability signal. Never set muted=false; set volume only within 0-1; re-apply per video; expect Instagram to overwrite state between videos.
